hooks.text: 五张大型地图的战利品、敌人和天气都会变化，每次突袭必须及时撤离，否则可能失去全部收获。
hooks.excerpt: Vast Maps, Random Adventures Across five unique maps, ever-changing loot, elusive enemies, and shifting weather ensure no two expeditions are the same. Every raid is a surprise, offering a unique experience each time. But don't forget to extract in time, or you might lose everything...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 搜出的药品、装备和收藏品可带回出售，收益用于升级基地；不起眼的废料还能在工作台加工成有价值物品。
hooks.excerpt: Scavenge and Thrive Scour the maps for valuables—meds, gear, rare collectibles. You never know what you'll uncover! Bring them back, sell for profit, and use your earnings to upgrade your Base and grow stronger. Think it's all junk at first glance? With the right touch at your workbench, scrap can become treasure.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 超过50种武器覆盖枪械与木棍，可选择近战、远程、正面交锋或伏击，并用扩展模组系统打造专属武器。
hooks.excerpt: Mod Your Weapons, Fight Your Way Choose from over 50 weapons, ranging from top-tier firearms to a common wooden stick. Go loud in close combat, pick off enemies from a distance, challenge them head-on, or set up an ambush. And with an extensive mod system, you can build your ultimate weapon.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
